incident-bot: PAGER — Sev2 detected on inference-hosted-prod (INC-2026-042). Alert: error-rate > 5% on /v1/generate for shard us-east-1a for 2m. Autogenerated runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/INC-2026-042

olivia_oncall: ack. I’m looking. Sam, can you grab a quick histogram of 5xx types and any recent deploys? I’ll start customer impact triage.

sam_prod_sre: on it. Pulling logs now. saw a spike of 503 + some OOMs from gpu-e2 nodes. No deploys in the last 30m. Running quick mitigation: scaling pool and routing away from suspected nodes.

sam_prod_sre: ```
# scale up pool
rctl scale pool gpu-e2 +20%
# move 10% traffic to fallback-v2-quant
rctl route set --service inference --traffic fallback-v2-quant=10%
```

olivia_oncall: thanks. Ashley, do we have any customer tickets? if so list orgs + severity.

ashley_support: RH-1259 opened by AcmeAnalytics — reports increased errors and timeouts starting ~22:15 UTC. Also FYI Support saw Slack DM from BetaCorp — they observed some failures but lower volume.

maria_pm: tagging in @maria_pm — need a short blurb for account teams. Which customers are impacted and are SLAs at risk?

olivia_oncall: preliminary: 3 customers with visible errors, estimated <1% of total revenue traffic. No SLA credits likely but must confirm after postmortem.

jim_ops: adding timeline to incident doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-042/timeline — please add notes as you confirm.

lee_eng: quick note: from stack traces looks like a KV-cache expunge path hitting a kernel path that causes a spike in memory pressure on certain kernel+driver combos. Hypothesis: rare GC loop exacerbated by concurrent long sequences. I’ll own deep-dive. ETA ~72 hours (investigation + fix PR).

sam_prod_sre: rollback to v2.1.3 attempted — no repro. Scaling + routing reduced 5xx from 6.7% -> 1.4% in last 10m. continuing monitoring.

olivia_oncall: good. we should still schedule a proper post-incident review. Propose postmortem readout: 2026-03-18 16:00 PST. All parties, pls confirm.

maria_pm: that works for me. Please include customer-facing summary and action items so I can coordinate comms.

sam_prod_sre: I’ll take the overnight handoff. @olivia_oncall handing to @sam_prod_sre at 23:00 UTC. I’ll keep the mitigation in place and validate overnight metrics.

olivia_oncall: thanks. Quick list of action items (owner — size — priority — Q2 tie-in):
1) Deep dive RC and fix for KV-cache expunge (lee_eng) — estimate: 3d engineering + 1d testing — priority: P0 (Sev2) — Q2 focus for runtime reliability OKR.
2) Add fallback routing automation and DR policy (sam_prod_sre) — estimate: 5 dev days (1 sprint) — priority: P1 — tie to quarterly SLO automation initiative.
3) Tune alerts to avoid noisy GC-triggered paging (jim_ops) — estimate: 1d config + 1d rollout — priority: P2 — include in monitoring backlog for next sprint.
4) Customer comms + postmortem summary (maria_pm + ashley_support) — estimate: 2d to draft & approve — priority: P0 for affected accounts — deliverable: pre-read 24h before readout.
5) Add integration test for long-sequence KV-cache behavior (lee_eng + eng-runtime) — estimate: 3-5 story points — priority: P1 — plan into sprint planning.
6) Runbook refinement: add step to automatically route 10% to fallback after sustained 5xx threshold (olivia_oncall) — estimate: 4h doc + 1d infra change — priority: P1.

olivia_oncall: I’ll create ticket tracking for each action and tag owners. Please add sizing estimates to the tickets and set target due dates (preferably within Q2). I’ll link to the incident doc and the quarterly plan page.

sam_prod_sre: created tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RH-2026-INC042 — added initial tasks and assignees. Will update estimates in the morning.

lee_eng: acknowledging ownership on RC work. Starting local repro now; will post progress to the incident doc. Initial plan: instrument expunge path, add metrics, reproduce with long tokens.

maria_pm: once we have postmortem draft, I’ll prepare customer notes and coordinate with legal/account for any contractual follow-ups.

ashley_support: flagged impacted accounts in CRM and opened support tickets with priority. Will add links to incident tracker.

olivia_oncall: thanks everyone. After-action items: - schedule postmortem readout (maria + olivia) - ensure tickets are sized and prioritized into Q2 plan (product + eng managers) - verify monitoring changes in canary before full rollout (ops).

sam_prod_sre: night handoff complete. I’ll post a short status update at 04:00 UTC. If anything spikes, page oncall via PD as usual.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status: mitigated -> degraded -> monitoring. Current error-rate 1.1%. Keep thread updated.

olivia_oncall: closing live coordination. Postmortem scheduling and action-item tracking in the incident doc. Everyone please add any missing owners/estimates by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
